Warning against Alpha Methyltryptamine and 5-MeO-DALT  POISON & TOXIC
I just want to introduce myself as a self experimenting medical student of psychedelics and RCs.  There are some amazing mind-opening substances out there.  And by mind opening I mean literally cracking the space time continuum to understand another dimension.  Sadly, I am writing this report as a warning against two research chemicals that are often advertised as psychedelics but are very toxic.
I want to first explain 5-meo-DALT.  I ordered 1 gram of this substance and tried it twice.  The first time I took 20 mg to test it out.  I find it more of a stimulant and was extremely hard to sleep on.  A few days later I attempted 60mg and some of the reported effects came through but the negatives were far outnumbered.  I was extremely nauseous for nearly 4 hours and developed a headache.
I was extremely nauseous for nearly 4 hours and developed a headache.
As the trip developed I could feel my kidneys working overtime and getting sore as well as some stomach issues.  The following day I was ill and my stomach was very sore... like I just had a hard night of drinking.
Next is Alpha Methyltryptamine (AMT).  This substance is far more dangerous then 5-MeO-DMT. It has two reported, but unconfirmed, deaths.  First time I tried 20 mg of it and noticed the effects.  Very similar to a very a low dose of mushroom... however... a very potent stimulant.  Its stimulant effects lasted far longer than the psychedelic effects (~15 Hours) and I spent the entire night not sleeping.  The next day I had a headache and was dizzy, however I assumed this was from not sleeping.
About 5 days later I sampled the AMT again... this time at 40 mg.  I went out to karaoke with friends and had 3-4 drinks as well.  I was hoping the additional dosage would increase effects, it did not.  Later that night (6 hours later) I got home and again, being unable to sleep, I decided to smoke about 20 mg of AMT with some cannabis.  The effects of the AMT stayed the same and only the effects of the cannabis were felt.  I spent the night unable to sleep again.
This is where the toxicity comes in with AMT.  Total dose was 60 mg over a 6 hour period.  The next day I was a wreck and the stimulant effects were felt for well over 24 hours with headache and dizziness.  The next night I had dinner and attempted to finish off some work and began getting sick.  I spent the second night throwing up everything I put in my body, including water.  I had sever headache, body ache, and diarrhea as well.  The third day my entire body was a wreck.  I could not definitely diagnose the situation, but I am certain that the 60 mg of AMT had initiated serotonin syndrome... something that can cause death.  This is my first experience of this and I do not ever want to experience it again.  It is now the 4th day and I am still dizzy, weak, having diarrhea, and a slight headache.  I essentially feel like I was poisoned.
Most psychedelic substances I can take in very large doses and are quite safe with almost no side effects.  Not these. Anything that causes extreme side effects like the above at under 100mg I consider toxic!  Please... if anyone decides to experiment with these... be very very careful.  There are not enough negative experience reports out there on these substances and had I read reports such as the one I am writing... I wouldnt have wasted my money.
Please be safe and enjoy!  I hope this report helps a few of you out there narrow your list of RCs to experiment with!  Take care all!
